The source digest above is the digest of the CURRENT docs/design/padel-friend.pen bytes at export time and is re-checked against the file by test/leagues.standings.visual-references.test.ts. Frame xbIxj depicts a T15 score correction (Community Admin amendment); PAF-12 intentionally adapts that composition to the truthful late-first-confirmation publication copy and never depicts an amendment, so only composition and tokens are compared. Supplemental states without an approved frame (all-zero, threshold-met, closed-empty, unavailable/retry, multiple history versions, no-active-League guidance x2GG9U, pt-BR dark 320px reflow) are gated by structural probes only; no budget exists for them.

visualBudgets.measurementMethod: Capture the 390x844 viewport at Chromium deviceScaleFactor 1 (ywfn7 dark, xbIxj light, en). Downsample only the uncropped 2x Pencil PNG. Mask every block with a documented composition delta: the referenceMasks rects below (Pencil frame coordinates) plus the matching production blocks (page header, details card, each child of the standings section, every block after it), each with a 1px margin. Compare the remaining pixels with the same-size RGBA pinned perceptual threshold (35215 x 0.1^2); reject any dimension mismatch before applying the per-screen budget, and reject masks above maxMaskedFraction.
visualBudgets.reason: The budget covers only the unmasked raster (page background, gutters, shell). Content and composition deltas are never absorbed by it: they are masked, listed in compositionDeltas, and gated by exact structural probes. Budgets are the smallest two-decimal-or-better value above the measured scoped residual with at most 0.02 headroom. The xbIxj mask cap is 0.89: fixed reference geometry and dynamic production block heights measured 0.869990, leaving about 0.02 headroom while guarding against silently growing masks; it does not change the raster budget.

xbIxj.name: bottom tab bar (app shell navigation, not rendered on the League route)

perScreenRationale.ywfn7: Scoped to the unmasked 9.6% of the frame (background, gutters, bottom shell). Measured scoped residual 0 (full frame 0.19135 is informational only: it is dominated by the documented content/composition deltas listed in compositionDeltas.ywfn7). 0.005 is the minimum nonzero budget for renderer variance and stays within the 0.02 headroom rule.
perScreenRationale.xbIxj: Scoped to approximately the unmasked 13% of the frame (background, gutters, bottom shell). Three consecutive runs after masking the mock-only bottom tab bar measured scoped residual 0; full-frame residual approximately 0.10814 is informational only and dominated by documented composition deltas. The unchanged 0.01 budget leaves 0.01 for raster variance.

maskedContentCoverage.policy: Masks exist only for documented unavoidable content differences (Pencil mock copy and composition differ from production data). Every masked region is still certified by (a) exact geometry probes (structuralProbes) and (b) computed-style assertions that resolve each element's color, background-color, border-radius, padding/gap, font-family, font-size and font-weight to the design tokens in design-tokens/dist/tokens.css (via a computed-style probe, so hardcoded values or a wrong token fail), plus the active theme's palette value and a few literal values that mirror the Pencil frame. Implemented by assertDesignSystemStyles in e2e/league-standings-visual.ts and run from league-standings.spec.ts.

d6ANDN.reason: The frame is a full-screen route; production adapts it to a Base UI alertdialog modal over the League page (scrim, dialog card, Cancel first so the safe action holds initial focus). A full-frame comparison therefore measures the page behind the scrim (0.8512 changed pixels), not the dialog; a budget that large would mask any defect, so no screenshot budget exists. The dialog is certified by the exact structural probes above instead.
